impact_summary.value: 관찰된 설비 설계·예방정비 문서화·소독제 유효성 시험 및 환경 모니터링의 미흡 사항은 제품 품질을 저해할 수 있는 오염 위험, 유지관리 절차의 불명확성, clean room 분리주 미사용 및 작업자 지문 채취 부적절성과 관련됩니다. 이 양식은 관찰사항이며 FDA의 최종 적합성 판단은 아닙니다.

evidence.quote: Equipment used during the (b) (4) drug substance manufacturing operations occurring in the manufacturing building (o) (4) at your facility are not adequately designed to ensure the prevention of contamination of equipment or product by environmental or processing conditions that would be expected to have an adverse effect on product quality.

Your disinfectant efficacy study is inadequate. Specifically, Qualifications of (b) (4) (report VLP-FR-8020) and (6) (4) (report VLP-FR-8453) conducted on February 3, 2014 and December 11, 2023, respectively, were performed without the use of clean room isolates.
The fingerprint collection of the operator was not conducted properly (e.g., without rolling on the contact plate).
